server.name: fuel-stations-spain-mcp
server.instructions: MCP server for Fuel Stations Spain API. Query real-time fuel prices, historical data, and municipality information for gas stations across Spain.

tools.name: compare_fuel_prices
tools.title: Compare Fuel Prices
tools.description: Compare a specific fuel type price across multiple stations. Filter by station IDs, municipality, or get the cheapest options. Returns stations sorted by the selected fuel price (ascending).

parameters.name: fuelType
parameters.description: The fuel price field to compare

parameters.name: ids
parameters.description: Array of station IDs to compare

tools.name: find_cheapest_fuel
tools.title: Find Cheapest Fuel
tools.description: Find the N cheapest stations for a specific fuel type. Can search globally or within a geographic radius. Results sorted from cheapest to most expensive.

parameters.name: fuelType
parameters.description: The fuel price field to search

parameters.name: distanceKm
parameters.description: Search radius in km (10-50). Required when coordinates are provided

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Number of cheapest stations to return. Default: 10

tools.name: get_database_status
tools.title: Get Database Status
tools.description: Check the status of both databases (SQLite realtime and PostgreSQL historic). Returns the last update timestamp, total station count, and PostgreSQL connectivity status.

tools.name: get_station_info
tools.title: Get Station Info
tools.description: Get complete details of a specific fuel station by its ID. Returns all available information including address, coordinates, opening hours, and all current fuel prices.

parameters.name: stationId
parameters.description: The unique ID of the fuel station

tools.name: list_municipalities
tools.title: List Municipalities
tools.description: List Spanish municipalities with optional filters for province, region, or text search. Returns municipality IDs, names, province, and autonomous community (region).

tools.name: query_fuel_stations
tools.title: Query Fuel Stations
tools.description: Search for fuel stations in Spain by ID, municipality, province, or region. Returns current fuel prices and station information. Use limit and offset for pagination.

parameters.name: ids
parameters.description: Array of station IDs to lookup

parameters.name: regionId
parameters.description: Filter by autonomous community region ID

tools.name: query_historic_prices
tools.title: Query Historic Prices
tools.description: Query historical fuel prices for a specific station over a date range. Returns a time series of prices sorted chronologically. Maximum date range is 1 year. Optionally includes current prices.

parameters.name: stationId
parameters.description: The unique ID of the fuel station

parameters.name: includeCurrentPrices
parameters.description: Include current day prices in results. Default: false

tools.name: search_stations_by_location
tools.title: Search Stations by Location
tools.description: Find fuel stations within a geographic radius. Provides the center coordinates (latitude, longitude) and a distance in kilometers (10-50 km). Returns all stations inside the search area with their current fuel prices.

resources.name: database-info
resources.description: Current status of the databases: connection state, total station count, and last update timestamp.

resources.name: fuel-types
resources.description: List of all available fuel types with their field names, Spanish names, and units. Use the field names when querying prices via tools.

resources.name: historic-schema
resources.description: Schema definition of the HistoricFuelStation table (persistent historic data). Shows all available fields with their types and descriptions.

resources.name: municipalities-list
resources.description: Complete list of all Spanish municipalities with their IDs, province, and autonomous community (region).

resources.name: stations-schema
resources.description: Schema definition of the FuelStation table (realtime data). Shows all available fields with their types and descriptions.
